fridge inspection की कीमत क्या है? Replacement parts भी शामिल हैं?
assistant: AC servicing six hundred ninety nine rupees aur fridge inspection three hundred ninety nine rupees hai. Parts extra hote hain aur sirf aapki approval ke baad hi lagaye jaate hain, inspection ke bina koi fixed repair quote nahi milta. Kya aap visit book karna chahenge?
user: मुझे AC servicing नहीं चाहिए, लेकिन fridge की जाँच चाहिए। क्या मदद कर सकते हैं?
assistant: ठीक है, fridge inspection three hundred ninety nine rupees mein ho jayega. Agar aapko visit chahiye toh apna naam, locality aur preferred date bata dijiye.
Caller shared contact details for the team to follow up.
